cards.title: Step-level Objective

ratio.tooltip: How much more (or less) likely the CurrentModel is to produce this token relative to the OldModel. Decides which direction to push this token's probability.

advantage.tooltip: Advantage computed via GAE: a discounted sum of TD errors. Roughly, how much better the outcome turned out than the value model expected. Decides how strongly to update.

clip.tooltip: Clips Ratio whenever it falls outside [1−ε, 1+ε]. A safeguard that prevents the current model from shifting too far in a single step. ε is a hyperparameter (typically ~0.2).

cards.description: Differentiating with respect to the model parameters yields the gradients used for optimization.

cards.title: What aggregation does

sections.label: Implicit Token Weight
sections.katex: \frac{1}{N \cdot |o_i|} \quad \left\{ \begin{aligned} &N = \text{Prompt Set Size (Prompts per step)} \\ &|o_i| = \text{Response Length (Tokens in } i\text{-th response)}, \htmlClass{term term--length-bias}{\text{Length bias}} \end{aligned} \right.

cards.description: During differentiation, the normalization term remains as a constant factor and is multiplied to each token's gradient.

sections.label: **Advantage (GAE)** controls how much to optimize
sections.katex: \begin{aligned} &\htmlClass{term term--delta_t_top}{\delta_t} = \htmlClass{term term--reward_t}{\text{Reward}_t} + \htmlClass{term term--gamma_top}{\gamma}\cdot\htmlClass{term term--value_t1}{\text{Value}_{t+1}} - \htmlClass{term term--value_t}{\text{Value}_t} \\ &\htmlClass{term term--advantage_sum}{\text{Advantage}} = \htmlClass{term term--delta_t}{\delta_t} + (\htmlClass{term term--gamma}{\gamma}\htmlClass{term term--lambda_first}{\lambda})^1\,\htmlClass{term term--delta_t1}{\delta_{t+1}} + (\htmlClass{term term--gamma}{\gamma}\htmlClass{term term--lambda}{\lambda})^2\,\htmlClass{term term--delta_t2}{\delta_{t+2}} + \cdots + (\htmlClass{term term--gamma}{\gamma}\htmlClass{term term--lambda}{\lambda})^N\,\delta_{t+N} \end{aligned}

current_model.tooltip: The current model being trained — its parameters are updated each gradient step. Its probability for the token is the numerator of Ratio.

old_model.tooltip: A frozen snapshot of the current model from when this response group was generated (rollout phase). Used as the Ratio denominator so the reference doesn't drift mid-update.

reward_t.tooltip: Reward at step t. In LLM tasks it is usually 0 except at the final token; GAE uses the value model to spread that final signal back to earlier tokens.

value_t.tooltip: Value model's prediction of expected future reward from this token position. Acts as the baseline so we only learn from outcomes that beat the prediction.

value_t1.tooltip: Value model's prediction at the next token. Combined with the immediate reward to form a bootstrapped estimate of the return expected from step t.

gamma.tooltip: Discount factor (0–1). Controls how far into the future rewards still matter. Lower γ = the model cares less about distant future rewards.

gamma_top.tooltip: Discount factor (0–1). Controls how far into the future rewards still matter. Lower γ = the model cares less about distant future rewards.

lambda.tooltip: GAE bias-variance knob (0–1). λ=1 = use the full future reward (less biased but noisier). λ=0 = use only the next step (less noisy but more biased). Picks a middle ground.

lambda_first.tooltip: GAE bias-variance knob (0–1). λ=1 = use the full future reward (less biased but noisier). λ=0 = use only the next step (less noisy but more biased). Picks a middle ground.

delta_t.tooltip: TD error at step t: how much this step beat the value model's prediction. The atomic 'surprise' signal that GAE accumulates.

delta_t_top.tooltip: TD error at step t: how much this step beat the value model's prediction. The atomic 'surprise' signal that GAE accumulates.

delta_t1.tooltip: TD error one step into the future. GAE down-weights it by γλ to fold its surprise into the current advantage.

delta_t2.tooltip: TD error two steps ahead, down-weighted by (γλ)². Far-future surprises contribute exponentially less.

advantage_sum.tooltip: Discounted sum of TD errors over future steps. Combines many noisy single-step signals into one credit value — more stable than raw returns, less biased than the value model alone.
